caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a human head and neck in profile view, facing to the left. The bust appears to be sculpted from a material resembling light brown or beige wood or terracotta, suggested by the color and texture rendered in the illustration. The head features long hair that is combed back smoothly and gathered into a bun at the back, with additional twisted strands forming a rope-like style looped around the bun. Distinct lines indicate the texture of the hair, following its direction. The face has defined features, including a straight nose, closed lips, and a visible eye and ear. The neck is elongated and connects to a truncated base, which is cut off at an angle. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white or light beige color with some faint discolorations and no additional objects or patterns.
title: Carved Silhouette of a Woman
